summary: Mandarin has no one general equivalent of English be: 是 handles central equative/nominal predication, many adjective predicates stand directly, 在 handles location, and 有 handles existence/possession.

semantic_map.SEM.CHARACTERISTIC_PROPERTY: stative/adjectival predicate directly; do not insert 是 merely because English has be
semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: stative/adjectival predicate directly or state-specific construction
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: resultative/state predicate; no single general copular form
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: event-specific predicate such as 在…举行/发生; not a general 是 rule
semantic_map.SEM.TIME_DATE_PREDICATION: 是 may occur in identificational time/date predication; direct temporal predication also occurs
semantic_map.SEM.ORIGIN_AFFILIATION: 是…人 / 来自… according to meaning
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: 有 is a central possessive predicate closely related to existential 有
